get_artifact: get detailed artifact information by artifact ID from the orchestrator server
get_artifact_uri: get the download URI for a given artifact ID from the orchestrator server
upload_text_log_artifact: upload a text log artifact with robot job ID, robot ID, and file bytes
disconnect: disconnect the OrchestratorArtifact client by clearing its orchestrator server connection
init_OrchestratorArtifact: initialize an OrchestratorArtifact client with a discovery Resource connection to the orchestrator
